reason: An agent orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness that detects repetitive reasoning, retries selected failures, and continues apparently unfinished turns with configurable pause and retry limits.

summaries.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体编排插件，可检测重复推理、重试选定失败并在任务未完成时自动续跑。
summaries.en: An agent orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness that detects repetitive reasoning, retries selected failures, and continues turns that appear unfinished.

capabilities: Monitors and interrupts repetitive LLM reasoning streams
Automatically retries selected failed or interrupted turns
Automatically continues completed turns when work appears unfinished
Registers a pause_work tool to suppress automatic continuation
